name: mailbox-signin-link
description: Connect, reconnect or sign in to the principal's Gmail and Google Calendar: mints a one-time sign-in link the principal opens and approves with Google, so a mailbox can be connected or an expired one reconnected. Use it when the principal wants to connect Gmail or fix a mailbox that stopped working. It works for any of the principal's own verified email addresses (the primary unless mailbox_address names another); a brand-new account that is not a verified address yet is added by the operator from the console. You never see the Google account or any credential; the link is the only output. Pass for 'curia' only during setup, to sign in Curia's own mailbox.

inputs.for: string? ('principal' (default) signs in the principal's own Gmail, pre-filled with their address; 'curia' signs in Curia's own mailbox and is accepted only from setup-wizard)
inputs.mailbox_address: string? (one of the principal's verified email addresses, to connect or reconnect that mailbox; defaults to their primary address; an address that is not theirs is refused)
inputs.mailbox_label: string? (a short name for the mailbox, e.g. 'Work'; optional)

outputs.sign_in_url: string (the one-time link to send the principal)
outputs.expires_at: string (local ISO timestamp when the link expires)
